description: Opt-in project-control guard for configured repositories.

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then root=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; else root=$PLUGIN_ROOT; fi; exec /bin/sh "$root/hooks/run-project-control.sh" project-control-session-start'
/bin/sh -c 'if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then root=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; else root=$PLUGIN_ROOT; fi; exec /bin/sh "$root/hooks/run-project-control.sh" project-control-stop'
